evidence: All 12 browser, viewport, and theme cells completed the same public workflow with reduced motion enabled.
The finder returned both actual Wylie registry identifiers 043914 and 221912 before Dallas 057905 selection.
A six-digit deep URL selected Dallas over stored Houston state, and cross-page map handoffs retained the selected district.
Taxpayer / Grandparent, Reporter, and Parent lenses; Houston comparison and removal; and section navigation all completed.
Finance FY 2025, outcomes SY 2024, equity SY 2025, economics FY 2025, and national FY 2024 remained distinct and visible.
The $500,000 tax-model input, economic source disclosure, semantic tables, citation copy or selected-text fallback, and actual citation text were asserted.
CSV content was parsed and contained more than 10 rows plus the expected Dallas FY 2025 value.
PNG bytes were decoded, with width at least 600, height at least 200, more than 4 colors, and more than 1,000 non-background pixels.
Print media retained district identity, finance value, TEA source, more than four visible charts, and no chart clipping; the print action invoked window.print.
A bounded route inventory rendered /feed, /forensics, /geomap, /heatmap, /about, /sources, /map, /intel, /transparency, and /docs in both engines. The root route was exercised by the 12 core flows.
Dallas, Houston, Tioga, Pineywoods Community Academy, and Argyle each rendered populated finance content with the degraded banner and live-finance unavailable message hidden in Chromium and Firefox.

The forced 503 fixture displayed the actual-finance unavailable warning, hid live finance KPIs, and retained outcomes, economics, equity, bonds, the economic levers chart, equity bars, bond timeline, district geomap, and built-in heatmap in both engines.
Expected offline 503 responses were confined to the unavailable fixture; normal runs had zero unexpected same-origin 5xx responses.
